KEY_ID.description: GnuPG ID used for signing the reprepro repository (e.g. DEADBEEF).

TRUNK_RELEASE.description: Repository name to copy built packages to, creating a central trunk repository.

MAIN_ARCHITECTURE.description: Architecture on which to build 'Architecture: all' packages. Defaults to host architecture if unset.

PBUILDER_HOOKDIR.description: Directory containing hook scripts for pbuilder/cowbuilder.

PBUILDER_CONFIG.description: Path to a user-specific pbuilder configuration file.

USE_ORIG_VERSION.description: If true, preserve the version number from the changelog without padding.

REPOSITORY_KEYRING.description: Path to the keyring file holding the public key for signing repositories.

REMOVE_FROM_RELEASE.description: If true, remove packages from a release repository before processing incoming.

DEB_KEEP_BUILD_ENV.description: If true, keep a copy of the build environment on failure.

REPOSITORY_EXTRA.description: Comma-separated list of extra repositories for resolving dependencies.

REPOSITORY_EXTRA_KEYS.description: Comma-separated list of URLs with keys for extra repositories.

ADT.description: Control autopkgtest execution: internal, external, all, or skip.

USE_EATMYDATA.description: Control usage of eatmydata to speed up builds (true/false or auto).

USE_CCACHE.description: Enable ccache for fast recompilation of C/C++ code.

TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.description: Format string for the generated build timestamp.

UNRELEASED_APPEND_COMMIT.description: If true, append SCM commit to version number even if marked UNRELEASED.
